title: Use an Example
summary: Here is the best secret every pro engineer knows: every good library comes with working example code!

steps.title: Use an Example

quickCheck.question: Where can you find pre-made starter sketches that show how to use an installed library?
options: Under File > Examples in the Arduino IDE menu
Under Edit > Cut in the top menu
quickCheck.explanation: The File > Examples menu lists built-in example sketches provided by installed libraries.
quickCheck.warmupExplanation: Libraries include working examples under File > Examples so you can test them immediately!

quickCheck.question: Why is testing an official example sketch a smart first step when trying new hardware?
options: It proves your wiring and library work before you write your own code
It deletes old sketches so you have more disk space
It makes the Arduino board waterproof
quickCheck.explanation: If an official example works, you know your hardware, wires, and library are good. If your custom code later fails, you know exactly where the bug is!
quickCheck.warmupExplanation: Starting with known working code eliminates guesswork about whether the problem is in your wiring or your code.
